title: Supplementary code and Delft3D model setup for "Size- and Geometry-Dependent Channel–Flat Partitioning in Macrotidal Muddy Basins"
description: This repository contains the supplementary code and Delft3D numerical model setup associated with the manuscript "Size- and Geometry-Dependent Channel–Flat Partitioning in Macrotidal Muddy Basins". The repository includes Python scripts for tidal basin channel centerline extraction and Delft3D model configuration files, including grids, boundary conditions, and input parameters used for numerical simulations. These materials are provided to facilitate reproducibility of the analyses and numerical experiments.
